cases.task: Choose the safe keepalive accounting rule for an SSE loop that writes ready, immediately inspects an empty projection, then waits for configurable poll intervals. A page or event frame is also wire activity.

required_facts.text: The immediate projection pass after ready consumes no elapsed poll interval.
Counting that immediate pass makes poll_ms=5000 emit a nominal 10-second keepalive after only 5 seconds.
Only completed poll timers represent elapsed idle duration.
Any event or page frame resets the wire-idle keepalive cadence.
